title: Lesson 4: The 11-Trick - Multiply Any 2-Digit Number by 11
subtopics: Pattern recognition: when does carry happen?
learningGoals: Multiply any 2-digit number by 11 mentally by splitting digits and inserting their sum in the middle.
Handle carry correctly when the digit sum is 10 or more.
Extend the 11-trick to 3-digit and 4-digit numbers using adjacent pair sums.
coreIdeas: For x11: keep the outer digits, insert the digit sum in the middle.
When the digit sum is >= 10, the middle digit is the units of the sum and 1 is carried to the left digit.
The same pattern extends to 3-digit numbers by summing adjacent digit pairs along the number.

workedExamples.question: 11 x 32 = ?
workedExamples.method: Digits 3 and 2. Sum = 3+2 = 5. No carry. Answer: 352.

workedExamples.question: 11 x 76 = ?
workedExamples.method: Digits 7 and 6. Sum = 13 >= 10. Middle = 3, carry 1. Left digit 7+1=8. Answer: 836.

onboarding.coachIntro: Today you will master the x11 pattern step by step, first without carry and then with carry, so the shortcut stays clean in your head.
onboarding.placementRule: Start at group A. If the learner handles no-carry examples instantly, skip to group B.

mission.missionPromise: Start with easy x11 builds, then handle carry and stretch the same idea to bigger numbers.
mission.successCelebration: Well done. You can now use the x11 pattern accurately, with or without carry.

microLessonPattern: Coach shows the split-and-insert rule with a coloured diagram.
Board highlights the outer digits and the inserted middle sum.
Student fills in the middle digit before seeing the answer.
Carry rule is introduced as a natural extension, not a new concept.
Instant feedback shows exactly which digit was placed incorrectly.

sessionFlow.coachHook: We begin with the easiest x11 cases. Keep the outside digits, add them, and place that sum in the middle.
sessionFlow.boardDemo: Show 11 x 32 as 3 _ 2. Add 3 + 2 = 5 and write 352. Then show 11 x 43 as 4 _ 3, add 7, and write 473.
sessionFlow.readAloudPrompt: Use the outside-plus-middle rule. What is 11 x 32?
sessionFlow.tryPrompt: Your turn: build 11 x 43 with the same rule.
sessionFlow.instantFeedbackWin: Yes. You used the x11 pattern exactly right.
sessionFlow.instantFeedbackRetry: Keep 4 and 3 on the outside. Add 4 + 3 = 7 and place it in the middle. The answer is 473.
sessionFlow.reviewPrompt: Try these no-carry builds: 11 x 12, 11 x 31, and 11 x 24.

exercises.solution: Outer digits 3 and 2, sum=5, insert middle. Answer: 352.

screenplay.teacherLine: Welcome to the 11-trick! This is the most-loved shortcut in Grade 4 Vedic maths. One look and you will never forget it.
screenplay.boardAction: Show eleven_trick.svg with animated split-and-insert demo.
screenplay.fallbackHint: Watch the outer digits stay in place and the sum appears in the middle.

visual.title: 11-trick with no carry
visual.caption: Keep the outer digits and place their sum in the middle.

screenplay.teacherLine: 7+6=13 - that is over 9! So the middle digit is 3 and we add 1 to the left digit. 7+1=8. Answer: 836!
screenplay.boardAction: Animate carry arrow from middle to left digit. Show 7 -> 8 with +1 highlighted.
screenplay.fallbackHint: 8+5=13. Middle=3, carry 1 to 8 -> 9. Answer: 935.

visual.title: 11-trick with carry
visual.caption: If the sum is 10 or more, keep the units digit and carry 1 left.

screenplay.teacherLine: Watch me: 11 × 32. Keep the outer digits — 3 on the left, 2 on the right. Middle = 3+2 = 5. Write 3 | 5 | 2 = 352. One look, one answer!
screenplay.boardAction: Write 11×32. Draw blank: 3 _ 2. Reveal 3+2=5. Write 352. Box the answer.
screenplay.fallbackHint: Outer digits stay. Their sum fills the middle.

screenplay.teacherLine: Together: 11 × 36. Outer digits 3 and 6. Sum = 3+6 = ?
screenplay.boardAction: Write 11×36. Draw blank: 3 _ 6. Wait for student. Reveal 9. Write 396.

visual.title: Guided: 11 × 36
visual.caption: 3+6 = ? No carry needed.

screenplay.teacherLine: Watch the carry: 11 × 47. Middle = 4+7 = 11. Write 1 in the middle and carry 1 to the left. Left digit becomes 4+1 = 5. Answer: 517!
screenplay.boardAction: Show 11×47: 4+7=11. Arrow: middle=1, carry arrow to 4 → 5. Write 517.
screenplay.fallbackHint: When sum >= 10: middle = units digit, left digit += 1.

visual.title: 11-trick carry — Demo
visual.caption: 4+7=11: middle=1, carry 1 to left → 517.

screenplay.teacherLine: Together: 11 × 36. Sum = 3+6 = 9. No carry — less than 10. Answer: 396. Now 11 × 64. Sum = 6+4 = 10. Carry needed! Middle = 0, left = 6+1 = 7. Answer = ?
screenplay.boardAction: Show 11×64: 6+4=10. Middle=0, carry to 6 → 7. Wait. Reveal 704.

visual.title: Guided: 11 × 64
visual.caption: Sum=10: middle=0, left=6+1=7. Answer: 704.

screenplay.teacherLine: Detective work: 11×47. Distractors: 507, 517, 527, 537. Compute: 4+7=11, middle=1, carry → 4+1=5. Answer 517. The wrong ones differ by 10 — carry mistake!

screenplay.fallbackHint: Compute the middle sum, handle carry, then match.
